The resort follows an unplugged, no news no shoes concept and does not have televisions in the guest cottages. PSV offers an elegant approach to all inclusive resorts. PSV appeals to a variety of clientèle from all parts of the world, with daily direct flights from Toronto, New York, Miami and three flights a day from London Gatwick all heading into neighbouring Barbados, the journey couldn't be easier. PSV has partnered with local aviation specialist, Mustique Air, offering guests a private plane service for the last short hop from Barbados.   The personalized attentive service coupled with the ultimate privacy of the hillside cottages and luxury beach front villas offers an ideal option for those seeking magical honeymoon destinations as well as guests looking for all inclusive holidays but with the impeccable service one would expect from exclusive resorts. Company description: Located on the edge of the uninhabited highlands of West Iceland, four-star Hotel Husafell is an eco-friendly oasis of luxurious comfort and contemporary design that embraces local artistry and the Icelandic wellness lifestyle at its finest. Guests of Hotel Husafell resort enjoy relaxing in our outdoor geothermally heated swimming pools and playing Midnight Golf on our 9-hole course open 24-hours in summer. First-class dining in our renowned restaurant is an unforgettable experience with locally sourced ingredients and glacier views from the floor-to-ceiling windows. Our 48 well-appointed guestrooms feature unique details like heated floors, paintings by local artist Pall Gudmundsson and bath amenities made from Icelandic herbs. The property is family owned and operated by locals whose roots in Husafell date back seven generations. Hotel Husafell is the only hotel in Iceland that is fully self-sustainable, running on 100% clean, renewable energy produced in our on-site hydro-electric and geothermal power generators. Name: Vinnustofa Kjarval
Company description: Vinnustofa Kjarval is a private members' club and working space in the heart of Reykjavik, offering an inspiring atmosphere where creativity and productivity thrive. Our space is designed for professionals, entrepreneurs, and creatives looking for a unique environment to work, meet, and connect. Named after the legendary Icelandic painter Jóhannes Kjarval, whose studio was located on our top floor from 1929 to 1972, Vinnustofa Kjarval embodies his entrepreneurial spirit and boundless creativity. His influence is not just in the name - his original paintings still adorn our walls, infusing the space with his artistic legacy. Vinnustofa Kjarval is more than just a workspace - it’s a living gallery. We celebrate Icelandic art in all its forms, showcasing over 200 art pieces from old masters to contemporary artists. This collection represents the largest exhibition of Icelandic art available in Iceland, making our space as visually stimulating as it is professionally enriching. What We Offer: - Private Workspaces designed for focus and inspiration - Meeting Rooms equipped with modern technology - Event Spaces perfect for workshops, networking, and private gatherings - A vibrant community of professionals and creatives - Exclusive members-only events and networking opportunities - An unparalleled artistic atmosphere with Iceland's finest artworks At Vinnustofa Kjarval, it's not just about the space - it’s about the history, the people, and the ideas that come to life within these walls. Join us and become part of Reykjavik’s most inspiring and artful professional community.

Soti Lodge offers six double bedrooms and one triple, named after neighborhood mountains and lakes in the Fljót region. All rooms have a bathroom with a shower. The dining area and lounge have stunning views in all directions and envelop guests with warmth and coziness.  We serve our guests breakfast and dinner, with an optional packed lunch available for a small fee. A breakfast buffet provides the necessary energy for a day of adventure in the Troll Peninsula, while a full service, three course dinner wraps up the days perfection.  At the Troll peninsula, all seasons of the year offer a natural beauty unlike any other. The area is known for Iceland's heaviest snowfalls and its jagged, rugged mountains. It is the ideal playground for active people seeking adventure and warm hospitality. Our guests can either explore the area on their own or do excursions through Sóti Summits, our sister company. We place a high emphasis on sustainable and responsible tourism, respecting nature and partnering with local tourism providers.

Við veitum aðstoð og ráðgjöf varðandi nauðsynleg leyfi, verðlagningu, hótelkerfi, vefsíðugerð, bókunarsíður, samningagerð við ferðaskrifstofur, starfsmannamál (ráðningu, þjálfun, vaktaplön og sölu- og markaðsherferðir. Við setjum upp verkferla sem fylgja hótelum og gistihúsum inn í betri tíma. Name: Panorama Glass Lodge Iceland
Company description: We are a family from Selfoss, south Iceland (originally from Switzerland and Germany) who had the idea in early 2015 to create an absolutely unique and romantic getaway in Iceland where it is possible to watch the northern lights and the midnight sun right out of the comfort of your bed or private hot tub. That’s why we designed the Panorama Glass Lodges®. Our Lodges were the first houses in Iceland (in 2017) where it is possible to sleep under a glass ceiling. Since then, Panorama Glass Lodge® has been the pioneer on the market and more variations of glass houses have been built around Iceland after this concept has been proven to be very popular. The most important point was for our guests to have an amazing, comfortable and unforgettable experience with enough privacy in the spectacular icelandic scenery. Therefore we decided to build just a few houses on a huge piece of land instead of many houses on a tiny piece of land to avoid the feeling of staying in a resort. Even though the cabins are out in the nature, our guests can still enjoy luxury, high quality standards and extraordinary design. The shape of the Lodges is inspired by scandinavian houses and the combination of wooden elements with steel and glass makes the Lodges unique. The interior is completely custom made and sustainable whereby high value was placed on the details. We respect nature and use only materials that do no harm to our beautiful surroundings. The water is the purest in the world, coming directly from a nearby spring. We use sustainable electricity to heat up our pools. We also use refillable cosmetics from the local brand Sóley Organics which are completely organic. At the beginning, the Lodges were meant for honeymooners and as a romantic getaway but when it got featured in several print and online media (i.e. Maxim, The Telegraph, Harper’s Bazaar, ELLE, Dwell, Süddeutsche Zeitung and many more – see “press/media”) a lot of Panorama Glass Lodge® is a registered trademark.
